title: Float Dust
statement: Implement `solve(values)`. `values` is a list of decimal strings such as `0.10`. Sum them with `decimal.Decimal`, quantize the total to two places with round-half-even (the default), and return the total as a string. Do not use binary float.
constraints: Each string is a base-10 decimal
The result always has two decimal places
hints: Construct Decimal from each string, not from a float.
Sum from Decimal(0), then quantize to Decimal(0.01).
str() of that Decimal is the return value.
editorial: 0.1 plus 0.2 is not 0.3 in binary floating point. Decimal parses the base-10 string you actually meant. Quantizing to cents after the sum matches a money display and avoids a long expansion of a repeating internal value.
